titulo.estudio: Un article qui propose des solutions : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: An article with proposals: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Connect a social problem with its causes, proposals and possible limits. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Connect a social problem with its causes, proposals and possible limits. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: causal and concessive connectors organise an argument; the conditional can present cautious proposals. In this passage, «collecte» means «collection».
